'''Cream of asparagus soup''' is a [[soup]] prepared with [[asparagus]], [[Stock (food)|stock]] and milk or cream as primary ingredients.

Ingredient variations exist.  Cream of asparagus soup may be served hot or cold,<ref name="Child" /> and the soup may be finished with various garnishes such as chives, [[crème fraîche]] and sour cream.
